bootstrap.hierarchy: Within every split: mean matched generation seeds per query, mean queries per target, equal target macro. Paired pipeline-minus-each-comparator differences at identical query/seed slots before aggregation. Single target: no CI. No pooling targets across splits.

analysis_plan.comparison_set: Every planned method and split; pipeline minus every other planned method, no favorable subset selection. Descriptive unadjusted intervals only; no significance/multiplicity claim.
analysis_plan.conditional_metric: Within each attempt having >=1 supplied replay-verified fully evaluated route, matched occurrences / fully evaluated route occurrences. Aggregate observed attempt ratios by query then target, retaining eligibility counts. Null without eligible routes, never fabricate zero; secondary selected-subset descriptive statistic only. Also report pooled occurrence fraction descriptively without occurrence-independent CI.
analysis_plan.coverage: Report attempts, accepted candidate occurrences, no_route_supplied, route_supplied, assessed/replay-verified, all_steps_evaluated, all_steps_matched, assessed_but_incomplete, evaluated_but_mismatched and audit_failed separately. Per-attempt counts, bounded any-output indicators and output-slot rates use all planned attempts; raw counts retain exact denominators.
analysis_plan.dependence: Occurrences sharing routes or identical reactant/context inputs are reuse, not independent samples; report unique route/input keys and repeated occurrences descriptively. No candidate-, reaction-, route- or seed-level iid uncertainty; cluster at target with query/seed hierarchy. Few-target and cross-target shared-input limitations remain explicit.
analysis_plan.design: Post hoc analysis plan specified while all generation and common forward assessment were incomplete; not preregistered confirmatory evidence. No comparative results computed to choose endpoints or subsets.
analysis_plan.infrastructure: Primary realized accepted return=0 for infrastructure_interruption. Separate [0,1] missing-counterfactual bounds for primary and all bounded any-output/slot coverage metrics on full grid, plus pipeline-comparator difference bounds; these are not CIs. Complete-case excludes only infrastructure_interruption, is selection-biased, retains other failures, and reports availability. Paired complete-case requires both outcomes observed.
analysis_plan.interpretation: Product-blind reactant-only input; same model as selection gate so selection-related enrichment is expected. Missing reagents/conditions and absent empirical context remain explicit. No predicted activity, biological validation, experimental synthesis, yield or synthesis probability claim.
analysis_plan.primary_definition: Indicator: at least one accepted returned candidate supplies a raw route that replays to the exact candidate and has a nonempty set of reaction steps, every common forward prediction status matched and all steps evaluated. All planned attempts remain in denominator; timeout/no_candidates/other terminal failures have no accepted returns.
analysis_plan.validation: Require all 630 unique planned method/query/seed entries, all 9 run-file input hashes from completed audit snapshot, frozen protocol/panel/source hashes, exact evaluation/raw-candidate rank+SMILES correspondence, exactly one occurrence per accepted candidate, derived cache keys, fresh rule replay and evidence-step correspondence. Refuse any comparative estimates until global grid/audit completion and integrity checks pass.
